{{Top|leg}}
A '''Thalassian luxury space barge''' was a model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Abran Balfour/Legends|Abran Balfour's]] personal ship, the ''[[Lady Telura]]'', was a [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] luxury space barge. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was considered a rare model, requiring specific parts in order to be properly maintained.
